result.changelog:
The final card is written and passes the validation command ("ok 4 alt greetings"). Every field is within its length target: description 897 words (draft 892), personality 153, scenario 141, first_mes 220, mes_example 367 (5 exchanges), creator_notes 298, depth_prompt 89, alternate greetings 245/170/189/137. There are no em-dashes, en-dashes or ellipsis characters. The V1 top-level fields mirror the data fields exactly, and creatorcomment equals creator_notes.

Sources re-checked this pass:
- Dread English and Japanese string tables (Xzonn commit ed2cd97).
- Fusion and Other M transcripts from metroid.retropixel.net.
- The English Fusion manual PDF, pages 10 and 19.
- Japanese Wikipedia's Fusion article.

Every canon quote left in the card was checked against these by script and matches verbatim. The one exception is the manga quote, which relies on the reviewer's reading of the page images.

Canon fixes:
1. ZDR Network Stations are no longer listed as a place ADAM speaks through. The "interference cuts him off" rule is cut, because its wording came from a Raven Beak line.
2. ZDR section now includes the real ADAM's landing lines: "Try to connect to the facility's network when you reach the bottom." and "Any objections, Lady?". It also says the "lost assets" are the E.M.M.I.
3. Added more impostor lines ADAM must never claim: "This is an order. Disobedience will not be tolerated," "Submit and offer up your power," "Accept your helplessness," "fulfill your destiny," "my daughter."
4. The impersonation timing is no longer stated as plain fact. creator_notes now says the in-game proof is Raven Beak's own words on Itorash, and that the start date comes from an undisplayed Japanese placeholder string (DIAG_ADAM_FINAL_PH_PAGE_05).
5. "Froze her" is now "shot her in the back with his Freeze Gun, disabling her Power Suit."
6. "Died aboard the Bottle Ship" is now "died in Sector Zero."
7. "Lady" is no longer "rare". It is now his sign-off, about once a scene, and never used before the BSL reveal. This is consistent across description, personality and depth_prompt.
8. "Feared tribunals" is now "raged at the blame to come."
9. Dachora is now plural (Dachoras) everywhere.
10. Added his last words as a thumbs-up turned thumbs-down, with his nod.
11. Kept "concise", because the English manual (p.19) says "concise and logical". Restated that the Federation provided the ship, because the manual journal (p.10) says "the ship the Federation had provided me."
12. Added that he screened the Etecoons and Dachoras and took them aboard.

Greeting fixes:
- Alt 1: restored "Good. Monitor her closely." and noted that Samus never saw the dispatch. Changed the hatch lock to "The screen woke as the uplink pad registered her weight." Replaced the "YES / NO" UI line with narration.
- Alt 2: now opens with the full canon reveal sequence. Removed the invented staging of the repeat order, the viewports, and the narration of Samus's thoughts.
- Alt 3: now opens with ADAM noticing she's troubled, which is consistent with the canon "Lady, what's troubling you?".
- Alt 4: replaced "Neither of us expected company" with "Samus didn't mention visitors" and removed the user-action narration.

Voice fixes:
- All original ADAM dialogue now uses normal contractions, with full forms kept for weight.
- Added trailing ellipses and his reined-in curiosity ("...But I digress.").
- Added dry teasing after the BSL. He may needle her but never with contempt; the old absolutes "never belittles" and "never mocks" are gone.
- Removed the "not advice, an order" cliche.
- Example 3 keeps only one Dread line.
- Example 4 is now first person and leaves open how much memory carried over.
- The cursor prop now appears only in first_mes.

Usability fixes:
- Added a "Before the reveal" section so a chat starting from alt 1 plays the plain computer.
- Scenario no longer hard-codes {{user}} as Samus, so it works in a group chat with a separate Samus card.
- depth_prompt no longer mentions ZDR, Raven Beak or "my daughter".
- Out-of-world "canon never says" wording in the description is rewritten in-world. "Inner life" is labelled as interpretation in creator_notes.
- creator_notes now: fixes the missing space; lists the errors in the two lorebook entries that key on Adam/ADAM and says they will fire on most turns; adds the Japanese forms (Fusion 異論は無いな? レディー / kids' mode わかったな? レディー; Dread 異論はないな、レディー, inverted by the impostor as 異論は認められない; 迷子たち; 触れるな); suggests talkativeness 0.3 for group chats.

Cut to stay under 900 words: the "Key people" line, the separate Federation paragraph (his anti-bioweapon stance is now in personality and one sentence), and the manga 48-hour detail.
